intro: Report to Thomas is a quest in eastern Elwynn Forest concerning Guard Thomas's investigation into the missing Stormwind guards near the eastern waterways. An adventurer assists Guard Thomas at the eastern bridge by investigating the fate of his missing comrades and reporting back on the situation along the river.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now that you have both medallions, deliver them to Guard Thomas at the bridge so that he might know the fate of his murdered guards.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hello, friend. Have you discovered the fates of Rolf and Malakai?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have confirmed my fears, friend. The murlocs are a threat we cannot ignore.
